profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Scientific Research Corporation
profile.summary:
Growing up I was an avid video gamer, I spent countless hours on my PlayStation. I would play everything from sports games, to racing games, and even first-person shooters. If you name it, chances are that I’ve played it. In video games, one would have to solve a variety of problems that they would present to you whether it be defeating a small henchman to defeating one of the toughest bosses in the entire game. 

Another thing that made up my childhood was sports. I played basketball and soccer as kid. I even watched sports as a diehard which I continue to do so today.  From playing and watching it on TV, sports have shown me how effective team work can be and the success that comes along  if everyone performs their share of work. 

These two aspects have made up an enormous part of my background as a computer engineer. I take the problem-solving skills I obtained from playing video games and apply them to the complex engineering problems I am given. With my background in playing sports, I know how to cooperate with others on a team to achieve group success rather than individual success. I value the success of the group to be much greater than the success of a single person. 

I enjoy meeting new people and working with them to help solve the most complex of problems. I’m a team player who doesn’t care who takes credit as long as the entire team succeeds. 

If you feel that I can become a productive member of your team please free to connect with me and contact me.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
- Developed bit-level parsers for ASTERIX Cat 10/48 and AIS Types 1–5, enabling real-time ingestion and decoding of maritime and radar sensor data within the Garda C2 tactical platform
- Integrated AIS, ASTERIX, EO/IR, and camera feeds into a unified sensor fusion database to support live track generation and real-time tactical visualization
- Enhanced UI components in response to customer feedback, improving operator workflow, clarity, and overall situational awareness
- Led development of a live ADS-B decoder for Garda Air, supporting real-time aircraft tracking and airspace monitoring
- Implemented NATS with JetStream for message routing, retention, replay, and persistence, establishing a transparent, end-to-end data pipeline from initial sensor ingest to tactical map display.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Gitlab · Git · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Agile Methodologies

company.name: Highbury Defense Group, an Accelint company

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
- Supported the DARPA ACO Distributed Experimentation Environment (DE2) program by developing simulation plugins for the Next Generation Threat System (NGTS)
- Designed and refined entity behaviors and capabilities based on feedback from active and retired military personnel to more accurately mirror real-world systems
- Analyzed system metrics to identify performance bottlenecks and reduce redundancy within simulation pipelines
- Utilized third-party tools to simulate satellite detections and model communication latency between distributed entities
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Git · Collaborative Problem Solving · Customer Service

positions.title: Engineering Technician
positions.description:
- Assisted engineers in executing validation and stress tests on IC chips, including extreme temperature testing (hot/cold)
- Collected and organized device performance data during stress and reliability testing
- Supported remote engineering requests such as docking specific devices, adjusting TCU (Temperature Control - Unit) positions on load boards, and reconfiguring wiring and cable setups on test benches
- Set up and configured clock inputs and frequencies required for various chip tests
- Troubleshot chip contact issues (RESET errors) and resolved JTAG/Trace32 debugging issues to restore proper test functionality

positions.title: Student Assistant - Traffic Operations CalTrans (San Diego)
positions.description:
- Maintained and updated an MS SQL Server RDBMS database, ensuring accuracy and authenticity of monthly traffic data for San Diego County freeways
- Created charts, dashboards, and traffic reports using Excel, Report Builder, and Tableau to support transportation analytics
- Built an HTML-based website in MS Visual Studio to display traffic data by route, direction, and type
- Developed C# Windows Forms tools that enabled staff to input and manage information for newly installed field elements directly into the database
positions.insights: Skills: Tableau · Database Management · SQL · Microsoft SQL Server · Data Modeling

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
- Aided physical therapists by supporting patient therapy activities and exercises.
- Transported paperwork and documentation between departments to ensure smoother clinic operations.
